topic: AI changes education from reading textbooks to exploring things on screen. A developer on X built an entire interactive 3D tool of the human anatomy, with accurate models, in a single afternoon. Students stop imagining from a page and start looking; teachers who adopt AI can build interactive applications for their own classes.

Prime Agent just launched and is one of the only RLM agents. Most agents get a fixed set of tools and cannot make a new one; Prime Agent gets a whole workshop instead, so it builds whatever tool a task needs and learns over time what works and what does not.
